name: Bound Vec Replaces Remove-Add Pairs In Place

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: native release build, criterion benches (macOS arm64)
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Bound Vec Replaces Remove-Add Pairs In Place Hypothesis

### Hypothesis

`apply_list_changes` (used by every `bind_to_vec`) applies an update arriving as `Remove{i}` followed by `Add{i}` as two `Vec` shifts (two O(n) memmoves). Applying such an adjacent pair as one in-place assignment yields the identical vector in O(1).

### Scope Lock

**Tested mechanism:** coalescing an adjacent Remove/Add at the same index into an in-place write.
**Allowed changes:** `apply_list_changes` in `crates/src/collections/operators/apply_list_changes.rs`.
**Forbidden in this experiment:** changing emitted change sets, the remove-key bridge, any operator.
